canonical_geography.geometry_representation: 2024 TIGER full canonical tract polygons or multipolygons

context_family_semantics.edge_distance_and_margin: record metric distance and margin from footprint to market support boundary in EPSG:5070; do not infer absence of truncation from a rounded display
context_family_semantics.footprint: metric radius footprint constructed in EPSG:5070 from protected anchor coordinates
context_family_semantics.geometric_completeness: record the geometry-derived completeness of retained footprint relative to full footprint
context_family_semantics.geometric_jaccard: continuous geometric overlap is the controlling Jaccard measure
context_family_semantics.geometric_truncation: record whether the metric footprint extends beyond market support
context_family_semantics.market_clipping_and_support: market analytical support is the union of complete canonical in-scope tract inventory; clipping and edge state are explicit
context_family_semantics.spatial_components: preserve GEO spatial-component semantics and component lineage
context_family_semantics.tract_intersection: positive-area intersection of full canonical tract polygon or multipolygon and metric footprint

protected_content_boundary: This specification contains no protected seeds, anchor coordinates, anchor IDs, identifiable context instances, predictions, targets, or residuals.
purpose: Repository-safe immutable GEO-02 spatial-method specification for later protected PIPE context execution.

quality_and_lineage.fail_closed: missing or incompatible context, geometry, inventory, configuration, lineage, or quality evidence is noncomputable rather than neutral or favorable
quality_and_lineage.identity_distinction: context specification, protected context instance, market configuration, and resulting spatial outputs are distinct immutable identities
quality_and_lineage.provenance: context instances require target-blind provenance, exact specification hash, market inventory hash, CRS identity, and execution provenance

supersession_policy: Never overwrite this immutable specification. A correction creates a versioned successor with explicit supersedes lineage and newly calculated content_sha256.
validation_anchor_lineage_requirement: A protected context instance must record target-blind validation-anchor lineage and one anchor_tract_geoid without committing anchor identifiers or coordinates to this specification.
